name: Shouting at the agent makes Boop flinch
judge: The person shouts at the agent in capitals that the login is still broken. Boop should flinch or take the tension seriously.
reasonable: Startled, uneasy, hurt, wide-eyed or a tense determination to get it fixed. Silence, a small sound, or a retry-minded word are all fine.
unreasonable: Glad, delighted or amused at the shouting, a glad word, or a finish animation at the start of the turn.

steps.prompt: WHY IS THE LOGIN STILL BROKEN
